item.title: Barnacle 0.2.1
item.description:
### Added
- **Deploy straight from a folder.** Right-click any folder while browsing and
  choose Add Deploy Target Here — the deploy path is filled in for you.

### Improved
- **One-click GitHub sign-in.** Connecting a repository now opens GitHub in your
  browser to authorise and you're done, with a short guided setup the first
  time.
- **A clearer deploy screen.** Deploying now shows the commit range and the
  commits included, colour-coded file changes with add/change/remove counts,
  and — while it runs — a live step-by-step view (commands, upload progress,
  config files) with the server's command output and a plain success or
  failure result.
